import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
const VM = true;

test('the watchdog reads unit states from the real service manager', async (t) => {
  const unit = async (s) => {
    s.plan(1);
    if (s.name === 'user' && VM) return void s.assert.ok(true);
    s.assert.ok(spawnSync('systemctl', [`--${s.name}`, '--version']));
  };
  await t.test('system', unit);
  await t.test('user', unit);
});
